qualification.details: Chief General Manager : P.G. Degree in Social Work with specialization in Labour Welfare, Personnel Management and Industrial Relations P.G. Degree/Diploma in IRPM/Master in Labour Studies from the recognized University/Institute MBA with specialization in Personnel Management / HR /HRD from recognized University / Institute Minimum 22 years of cumulative experience, including a minimum of 15 years of experience in the HR/IR/Personnel discipline as an Executive in the HR/IR/Personnel Department of Central Public Sector Enterprise (CPSE), Central Government, State Government, Autonomous Body, or Private Sector organization of repute. At least 2 years' experience (1 year for internal candidates) in the immediate lower IDA pay scale or an equivalent CDA pay scale. For Private Sector candidates, annual CTC should be not less than ₹30.00 lakh.

Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.moil.nic.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 17-09-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MOIL Chief General Manager (Personnel) post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Chief General Manager (Personnel) post is 17th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a PG Degree in Social Work (specializing in Labour Welfare, Personnel Management, and Industrial Relations) or a PG Degree/Diploma in IRPM/Master in Labour Studies, or an MBA with specialization in Personnel Management/HR/HRD. The degree/diploma must be for a minimum of 2 years duration.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Chief General Manager (Personnel) post is 53 years. However, this upper age limit is relaxable for departmental candidates.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Chief General Manager (Personnel) position?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the post of Chief General Manager (Personnel) in MOIL.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the MOIL recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 700.00 plus GST for General/OBC/SC/ST/PwD candidates. SC, ST, and PwD candidates are not required to pay the fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Chief General Manager (Personnel) post?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 1,20,000-2,80,000 (E-08) in the IDA Scale.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of candidates followed by a Written Test and/or Interview.

faq.question: Q8. How should candidates apply for this position?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website, fill it out, attach necessary documents, and send it to the specified address.

faq.question: Q9. What is the minimum experience required for this role?
faq.answer: A minimum of 22 years of cumulative experience is required, with at least 15 years in the HR/IR/Personnel discipline as an Executive in specific organizations. An additional 2 years of experience in the immediate lower IDA pay scale is also necessary.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of MOIL, which is www.moil.nic.in.
